items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: So, so, Speedy Smith, a comedian, he said, by God, he says, how much do you owe you?

ctx.x: Oh. In fact, you just leave it there.

So, so, Speedy Smith, a comedian, he said, by God, he says, how much do you owe you? I said, you know, me, I'm all in my money. He said, I'm going to get some of them. I said, don't worry about it. I think you'll get some money. He went in there. And I remember hearing him say, man, Cook, if you don't give me my money, I'm going to blow your damn brains out. Yeah. I get him. And I heard something like him putting a gun on. And I heard something like him putting a gun on. You know, he came out and gave me $16. I…
So finally you made it back to school?
